name: directory.exists
description: Check whether a path exists and is a directory. Returns false for missing paths and for paths that exist but are files.

exists.description: True iff the path resolves AND is a directory. False for missing paths, files, devices, pipes, etc. Use `file.exists` for the polymorphic test.

x-implementations.name: get_file_attributes
x-implementations.description: Win32 `GetFileAttributesW`. Returns INVALID_FILE_ATTRIBUTES if the path doesn't exist (mapped to `exists: false`); otherwise checks the FILE_ATTRIBUTE_DIRECTORY bit.

windows-modern.description: GetFileAttributesW + FILE_ATTRIBUTE_DIRECTORY bit check. ERR permission_denied when ACL denies the read; ERR not_found becomes `exists: false` rather than an error (the verb's purpose is the existence check).

windows-classic.description: GetFileAttributesW on NT 5+; GetFileAttributesA on NT 4 / 9x. Same FILE_ATTRIBUTE_DIRECTORY bit check.
